notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33820238/984b23be3e399378c4919c78f6606bc0adca737e.png[/img]

Episode “Wonder Seeker” also continues in the new chapter as Mina’s search for the mysterious “Antilia” gives answers and raises more questions.
